name: Judge Protocol
description: Deterministic evaluator for ERC-8183 agent-job escrow on Arc. Runs deterministic checkers (checksum, schema with required fields and types, contains, length) on provider deliverables, plus an optional http-endpoint check, which is a live network probe recorded once at judging time. Commits a recomputable evidence hash on-chain as the verdict reason and settles escrow on Circle's canonical AgenticCommerce contract on Arc testnet. Anyone can independently recompute a verdict from public inputs via the verify CLI or the in-browser verifier. Contract live on Arc testnet; not yet deployed on Arc mainnet. The judging service is currently offline (last verdict Aug 7, 2026).
